summary.text: Barbara Quigley is the Republican candidate for the Rhode Island House of Representatives, District 22, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She advanced from the September 9, 2026 Republican primary.

paragraphs.text: Barbara Quigley previously ran as a Republican for Rhode Island State Senate District 15 in 2022, when incumbent Democrat Meghan Kallman defeated her in the general election.
